headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Panasonic MirAIe Air Conditioners
footerDisplay: Each AC appears as a primary accessory card in HomeKit (Power, Temp, HVAC Mode, Room Temp, Fan Speed, Swing). Extra switches (Eco, Powerful, LED Display, Converti) are dynamically detected and named based on the capabilities reported by your AC via the MirAIe MQTT broker.

username.title: Username
username.description: Your MirAIe account mobile number (e.g. 9876543210) or email address

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to poll the API for status updates (as a fallback to MQTT). Default: 300s (5 min)

enableDrySwitch.title: Enable Dry Mode Switch
enableDrySwitch.description: Expose a switch to toggle Dry / Dehumidify mode

enableEcoSwitch.title: Enable Eco Mode Switch
enableEcoSwitch.description: Expose a switch to toggle Eco mode

enablePowerfulSwitch.title: Enable Powerful / Turbo Switch
enablePowerfulSwitch.description: Expose a switch to toggle Powerful / Boost mode

enableDisplaySwitch.title: Enable AC Display LED Switch
enableDisplaySwitch.description: Expose a switch to toggle the AC front panel LED display

enableTemperatureSensor.title: Enable Room Temperature Sensor
enableTemperatureSensor.description: Expose a room temperature sensor service

enableCleanSwitch.title: Enable Self-Clean Switch
enableCleanSwitch.description: Expose a switch to toggle Self-Clean mode

enableConvertiControl.title: Enable Converti Capacity Control
enableConvertiControl.description: Expose a slider to control Converti capacity (40% to 110%)

enableSeparateFanService.title: Enable Separate Fan Speed Tile
enableSeparateFanService.description: Create a separate Fan tile. (Note: Fan speed is already integrated into the main AC card in HomeKit)
